name: kb-wiki-skill
description: kb-wiki skill scripts. Runtime: bun (preferred) or node >= 22.6 with --experimental-strip-types (>= 23.6 needs no flag) — no Bun-only APIs. @types/bun gives the editor ambient types; @anthropic-ai/sdk must be declared (not only auto-installed) because installing the dev types creates a node_modules/, which switches Bun to node-resolution and would otherwise break the SDK's runtime auto-install. Run `bun install` here for editor type-checking.
